comments.text: Post Section 45 of The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act 2015, insurance companies cannot question a life insurance policy after three years. The insurer has no right to reject a life insurance claim on the grounds of misrepresentation or suppression of material facts or even if the insured commits suicide after three years. A claim can be refused only if the life insured is involved in criminal activity or commits fraud while submitting claim documents.

comments.text: I have recently made buy Canara hsbc OBC online term insurance policy for 50 lacs. I have visit their enlisted lab to test medical. What you think that is okay ? But one of my friends didn't take medical tests in lic term insurance policy and his term insurance policy for 20 lacs. Please advise! Lastly one question a policy holder can take how many term insurance for his own life cover ? Any legal limit ?
comments.author: @goutammukhopadhayay2291

comments.text:
You got the medical test, that is good thing. LIC generally don't ask for medical test if sum assured is below ₹50 lakh.
There is no such limit that how many policies you can buy, however, you have to tell about all your existing policies while buying a new policy. If the underwriter finds that your cover is more, he will not allow new policy in your name.
My personal recommendation is that you should not take more than 3 life insurance policies.
